parts.text:

weight =  ................................................. [1]

parts.label: b
parts.text:
The bucket of oil is hung from a spring of unstretched length 20 cm. The limit of
proportionality of the spring is not exceeded and its length increases to 35 cm.

content.html: State what is meant by the limit of proportionality.

parts.text:

the mass of the oil in the measuring tank.
